description: This PHP class defines the ViewSourceProperties class, which extends ViewList, for rendering source property configurations in the SuiteCRM module related to connectors. It includes methods for initialization and display logic, involving fetching connector properties and preparing data for templating.

classes.name: ViewSourceProperties
classes.description: A view class for displaying source properties in the SuiteCRM connectors module, extending ViewList and providing display functionality for source configuration

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the ViewSourceProperties class, calling the parent constructor

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares and assigns connector source properties to the template engine, then renders the 'source_properties.tpl' template
